title: game_timeline assigns all events to the last turn
description:
The `scripts/analysis/game_timeline.py` helper is currently misleading even without `--turns` filtering. While fast-analyzing `game_20260309_162848`, the script printed the entire run with the prefix `T6 PRECOMBAT_MAIN (Opus Brewer)`, including the initial `=== GAME START ===`, mulligans, and early-turn actions.

Evidence from local analysis on 2026-03-12:
- `uv run python scripts/analysis/game_timeline.py website/public/games/game_20260309_162848.json` labeled the full output as `T6 PRECOMBAT_MAIN (Opus Brewer)`.
- The existing fast-analysis skill note already documents that `find_turn_at_ts` breaks `--turns` filtering by mapping events to the last turn.
- This run shows the same bug also contaminates the default unfiltered timeline, so analysts can misread which turn or player an event belongs to even when they avoid `--turns`.

Suggested fix: make the timeline derive labels from the nearest preceding snapshot/decision context, or omit turn/phase labels when `find_turn_at_ts` cannot resolve them correctly instead of silently using the final turn.
